# BuyCarbonCredit.in

BuyCarbonCredit.in is a small, independently operated marketplace for farmer-provided carbon-project listings. It is not a government agency, carbon registry, exchange, broker, verifier, certification body, or financial adviser.

## Primary pages

- Home: https://buycarboncredit.in/
- Farmer project listings: https://buycarboncredit.in/seller-listings
- Buyer due-diligence guide: https://buycarboncredit.in/global-buyers
- Farmer participation guide: https://buycarboncredit.in/how-to-sell-carbon-credits-india
- Marketplace registration explanation: https://buycarboncredit.in/carbon-credit-registration
- Farmer registration and payment form: https://buycarboncredit.in/contact
- Carbon-credit pricing guide: https://buycarboncredit.in/carbon-credit-price
- Carbon credits per acre explanation: https://buycarboncredit.in/carbon-credit-price-per-acre
- Scenario calculator: https://buycarboncredit.in/carbon-credit-calculator
- Educational articles: https://buycarboncredit.in/blog
- Terms and Conditions: https://buycarboncredit.in/terms

## Marketplace registration

The platform charges farmers a one-time ₹199 fee for submitting one marketplace listing. This is a private marketplace fee, not a government carbon-credit registration fee. It is not a subscription and does not automatically recur.

## Important limitations

- Listings contain information supplied by sellers.
- A listing is not an issued, certified, validated, or independently verified carbon credit.
- The platform does not issue, certify, transfer, or retire carbon credits.
- Registration does not guarantee project eligibility, verification, issued credits, buyer interest, a sale, price, payment, or income.
- Acreage and calculator estimates are illustrative and require independent assessment.
- Buyers and sellers are responsible for due diligence, agreements, professional advice, verification, registry procedures, payments, taxes, and legal compliance.

## Official Indian-market context

India's Carbon Credit Trading Scheme has compliance and offset mechanisms. Participation and issuance under the official framework depend on applicable Bureau of Energy Efficiency procedures, published methodologies, validation or verification requirements, and registry processes. Registration on BuyCarbonCredit.in is separate from official CCTS project registration.
